name: Rashin
source:
There was a strange woman in the castle I found in the forest. But I can not remember anything.

But why I have a sense of deceitfulness...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-january-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
我在森林里发现一座城堡，里面有个奇怪女人。但我什么都想不起来。

可为什么我感觉自己正在被骗……

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-january-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
